The software product **Mendeley** at **mendeley.com** is directly provided by **Mendeley Limited** (an Elsevier company).

### Evidence
According to the official *Mendeley Terms of Use* governing `mendeley.com`, its subdomains, desktop software, and related services:
> *"By using the Mendeley website at https://www.mendeley.com and its subdomains (the "Site"), and Mendeley desktop software (the "Software") or other products and services... The Services are provided by Mendeley Limited (“we”, “us” and “our”)."*
